source_claim: AlphaEvolve Section 3.3.2 contrasts Pallas search-based autotuning with manually crafted tiling heuristics: autotuning interrupts research workflows and requires retuning when input shapes change, while manual heuristic design is a major kernel engineering bottleneck requiring deep hardware expertise; AlphaEvolve is framed as automating manual tuning and improving Gemini kernel ergonomics
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve now separately tracks kernel shape-corpus/runtime evidence as a prerequisite. It does not claim baseline workflow class records, search-autotuning baseline records, manual-heuristic baseline records, hybrid expert baseline records, autotuning search-space evidence, retuning policy evidence, input-shape-change sensitivity, manual authoring or review effort, hardware-expertise assumptions, kernel engineer workflow impact, model-developer ergonomics impact, comparison of AlphaEvolve-generated heuristics against baseline workflows, baseline comparison artifacts, workflow-interruption evidence, or optimization-time reduction evidence.
